d:
Planning a budget trip to Gaya, Rajgir, and Nalanda? This is Episode 1 of your ultimate travel guide! We cover cheap hotels, the best local food, and all the transport tips you need. Watch how we managed this entire trip on a tight budget!
In this first leg of our journey, we show you exactly how to get from Gaya to the historic sites of Rajgir and Nalanda using the most affordable public transport options. We dive into finding the best budget accommodation and tasting authentic local street food so you can plan your own affordable and memorable adventure.
